``` { .sh .annotate linenums="1" }
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

SRC=/mnt/cephfs
MAX_AGE=$((2 * 60 * 60))  # (1)!
MAX_SKEW=60  # (2)!

export PBS_REPOSITORY='cephFS@pbs!cephFS@pbs1.mydomain.com:mnt-pbs'
export PBS_PASSWORD_FILE=/root/.pbs-cephfs-token

GATUS_URL="http://192.168.1.45:8085"
GATUS_ENDPOINT="plumbing_cephfs-backup"
GATUS_TOKEN_FILE=/root/.gatus-cephfs-backup-token

log() { echo "cephfs-backup: $*"; }

gatus_report() {
  local ok=$1 err=${2:-}
  if [[ ! -r "$GATUS_TOKEN_FILE" ]]; then
    log "no gatus token at $GATUS_TOKEN_FILE: result not reported"
    return 0
  fi
  printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$(cat "$GATUS_TOKEN_FILE")" \
    | curl -fsS -m 20 -o /dev/null -X POST -H @- -G \
        --data-urlencode "success=$ok" --data-urlencode "error=$err" \
        --data-urlencode "duration=${SECONDS}s" \
        "$GATUS_URL/api/v1/endpoints/$GATUS_ENDPOINT/external" \
    || log "could not report the result to gatus"
}

reported=0
tmpdb=""
on_exit() {
  local rc=$?
  [[ -z "$tmpdb" ]] || rm -f "$tmpdb"
  if (( rc != 0 && reported == 0 )); then
    gatus_report false "exit $rc"
  fi
}
trap on_exit EXIT  # (3)!

fail() {
  log "FAILED: $*"
  gatus_report false "$*"
  reported=1
  exit 1
}

[[ -d "$SRC/.snap" ]] || fail "$SRC/.snap not found: is cephFS mounted on this node?"

newest="" newest_ts=0  # (4)!
for dir in "$SRC"/.snap/scheduled-*; do
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || continue
  s=${dir##*/scheduled-}                      # 2026-09-25-13_00_00_PDT
  when="${s:0:10} ${s:11:2}:${s:14:2}:${s:17:2} ${s:20}"
  if ! ts=$(date -d "$when" +%s 2>/dev/null); then
    log "skipping ${dir##*/}: its name is not a time"
    continue
  fi
  if (( ts > newest_ts )); then
    newest=$dir
    newest_ts=$ts
  fi
done

[[ -n "$newest" ]] || fail "no scheduled snapshot under $SRC/.snap"
age=$(( $(date +%s) - newest_ts ))
(( age >= -MAX_SKEW )) \
  || fail "newest snapshot ${newest##*/} is dated $(( -age / 60 )) minutes in the future: is the ceph-mgr's clock right?"
(( age <= MAX_AGE )) \
  || fail "newest snapshot ${newest##*/} is $(( age / 60 )) minutes old: is snap_schedule running?"
[[ -e "$newest/.donotdelete" ]] || fail "${newest##*/} has no .donotdelete: not the docker cephFS"

portainer_db="$newest/portainer_data/portainer.db"
portainer_problem=""  # (5)!
if [[ -e "$portainer_db" ]]; then
  if ! { tmpdb=$(mktemp /tmp/portainer.XXXXXX) && cp "$portainer_db" "$tmpdb"; }; then
    portainer_problem="could not copy portainer.db from ${newest##*/} to /tmp to check it"
  elif out=$(timeout 300 bbolt check "$tmpdb" 2>&1) && [[ "$(tail -n 1 <<<"$out")" == OK ]]; then
    log "portainer.db in ${newest##*/} passes bbolt check"
  else
    portainer_problem="portainer.db in ${newest##*/} fails bbolt check: $(grep -m 1 -v '^[[:space:]]' <<<"$out" | cut -c 1-200)"
  fi
  [[ -z "$portainer_problem" ]] || log "$portainer_problem"
  [[ -z "$tmpdb" ]] || rm -f "$tmpdb"
  tmpdb=""
else
  portainer_problem="${newest##*/} has no portainer_data/portainer.db"
  log "$portainer_problem"
fi

log "backing up ${newest##*/}"
proxmox-backup-client backup "cephfs.pxar:$newest" \
  --ns Files \
  --backup-id cephfs \
  --change-detection-mode=metadata  # (6)!

[[ -z "$portainer_problem" ]] || fail "backed up, but $portainer_problem"
gatus_report true
reported=1
log "done in ${SECONDS}s"
```

1.  the newest snapshot may be at most two hours old. older means the schedule has stopped, and
    backing up the same snapshot every hour would hide that.
2.  nor may it be dated more than a minute ahead. a snapshot from a clock that jumped forward would
    otherwise stay the newest, and hide every later one while the same state was backed up.
3.  an exit that has not reported yet reports a failure to gatus, including one `set -e` causes,
    such as `proxmox-backup-client` failing.
4.  snapshot names carry the ceph manager's local time and zone, such as
    `scheduled-2026-09-25-23_00_00_UTC`, so the loop compares them as times. in text order, the
    hour that repeats when DST ends sorts wrong.
5.  portainer's database is checked in the snapshot with `bbolt check` before the backup. a copy that
    fails is still backed up, and the run then reports a failure, see
    [databases](databases.md#portainer-a-checked-copy-in-every-cephfs-backup).
6.  `--backup-id cephfs`, above, keeps every run in one group, `host/cephfs`, whichever node the
    container is on. the marker sits here because a line that ends in `\` must keep it last.
